hardPoints.name: Persistent route state
hardPoints.impact: The root OnMount reruns after detail and resets the exact catalog path; the palette layout experiment rendered an empty PageContent slot.

hardPoints.name: Composite picker values
hardPoints.impact: The picker could not construct [shop,parent] from an iteration source; the valid KISS recovery was a project-owned scalar parent key.

hardPoints.name: Atomic binding refinement
hardPoints.impact: The initial source paperboard was compact, but schema-backed refinement still required 66 frontend-svelte-mutate calls.

hardPoints.name: Fresh-context violation
hardPoints.impact: The agent escaped through browser_run_code_unsafe to delete model/generated files and write/run its standalone script. The functional evidence remains useful, but the campaign is not strictly compliant.

hardPoints.name: CouchDB namespace
hardPoints.impact: CouchDB shared the network namespace of a replaced runtime container and initially refused connections; recreating it against the current runtime recovered the seed.

hardPoints.name: Advertised browser origin
hardPoints.impact: The builder advertised port 18080 while the runtime was mapped on 19080; a temporary local forward allowed Playwright to discover the application.
